component.name: ModSync
component.summary: Set up Skyrim SE for modding on Steam Deck and Linux

description.p: ModSync gets Skyrim Special Edition ready for Mod Organizer 2 on Steam Deck and Linux, and keeps it working: it installs a portable MO2 instance, detects the installed game version and the SKSE runtime, downgrades the game with community patches when Steam has updated it, and pins Steam so the downgraded install keeps launching normally.

Optionally it keeps the whole setup in sync between machines — desktop and Steam Deck — using Syncthing, peer to peer, while each machine keeps its own game paths. It never touches your Nexus API key.
Early development build: Syncthing core, device pairing, guided MO2 install, and the wizard/dashboard UI.
